definitions.explanation: Describes something that lacks aesthetic refinement or shows poor judgment in taste. Can refer to choices in fashion, decor, humor, or behavior.

examples.japanese: {悪趣味|あくしゅみ}な⟦{冗談|じょうだん}→冗談：03347_joudan⟧
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{組|く}み{合|あ}わせ→組み合わせ：13794_kumiawase⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{悪趣味|あくしゅみ}だ。
examples.english: That outfit combination is in poor taste.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{不幸|ふこう}→不幸：03595_fukou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{笑|わら}う→笑う：00685_warau⟧⟦なんて→なんて：06918_nante⟧、{悪趣味|あくしゅみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{程|ほど}→程：01724_hodo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Laughing at others' misfortune is terribly tasteless.

notes:
FORMATION: {悪|あく} (bad) + ⟦{趣味|しゅみ}→趣味：00889_shumi⟧ (taste, hobby)

NUANCE: {悪趣味|あくしゅみ} can describe both aesthetic failures (garish clothes, tacky decor) and moral/social failures (inappropriate jokes, morbid interests). It carries a judgmental tone.

CAN FUNCTION AS: Na-adjective ({悪趣味|あくしゅみ}な...)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {悪趣味|あくしゅみ}な⟦{冗談|じょうだん}→冗談：03347_joudan⟧ (joke in bad taste)
- {悪趣味|あくしゅみ}な⟦{趣味|しゅみ}→趣味：00889_shumi⟧ (morbid hobby)
- {悪趣味|あくしゅみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{程|ほど}→程：01724_hodo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (that's going too far in bad taste)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{下品|げひん}→下品：00060_gehin⟧ (vulgar, crude)
- ⟦{趣味|しゅみ}→趣味：00889_shumi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ (to have bad taste)
- ⟦{無粋|ぶすい}→無粋：09182_busui⟧ (boorish, uncouth)
